Title: Stand-in Tier+Tactical Tier 1A
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the community Weapon_Package_Tier1A folder name, the
method names its port covers and the shape of its scripts, built on the
stand-in Tier 1 as the original is built on Tier 1, so the listed port
applies to it. It is not the original Add-On and holds none of its files,
and its guns and numbers are its own.
